youtube.title: Three wrong tries, then trace it: an emblem rebuilt with live Hebrew and English text
youtube.description:
Three early attempts to rebuild this emblem from shapes and typed Hebrew scored about 40/100 against the target. Tracing the artwork to vectors with funkbox's image_trace, lifting the lettering out and setting new live text on top scored 97/100, and the text audit checks every string exactly.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
